## Setup

```{r packages + settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(socsci)
library(geomtextpath)
library(coolorrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
library(patchwork)
set_palette(
  qualitative = c(
    "steelblue",
    "orange",
    "navy",
    "red",
    "green3"
  ),
  binary = c("navy", "orange"),
  sequential = c("white", "navy"),
  diverging = c("steelblue", "gray30", "red3")
)
source(here::here("_helpers", "splot.R"))
theme_set(my_theme())
saveit <- function(num = 1, ht = 5, wd = 7) {
  ggsave(
    here::here(
      "118_du_survey",
      paste0("fig", num, ".png")
    ),
    height = ht,
    width = wd,
    dpi = 500
  )
}
```


## Data

```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
gs4_deauth()
range_speedread(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1IEKyKbBL1S8FceOcPBrpbuGNV9hzpbI_J58mFHL7478/edit?usp=drive_link"
) -> raw_dt
```

```{r}
raw_dt |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    full_q = sum(
      c_across(c(q237, q238, q239)),
      na.rm = T
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    id = row,
    tr = frcode(
      foreignaidexperiment_do_q237 == 1 ~ "Control",
      foreignaidexperiment_do_q238 == 1 ~ "Chinese\nCompetition",
      foreignaidexperiment_do_q239 == 1 ~ "Government\nWaste"
    ),
    num_scale = (5 - full_q) - 2,
    cat_scale = frcode(
      full_q == 5 ~ "Much\nworse",
      full_q == 4 ~ "Somewhat\nworse",
      full_q == 3 ~ "No change",
      full_q == 2 ~ "Somewhat\nbetter",
      full_q == 1 ~ "Much\nbetter"
    ),
    pid = frcode(
      q3 %in% 1:3 ~ "Democrat",
      q3 == 4 ~ "Independent",
      q3 %in% 5:7 ~ "Republican",
      q3 == 8 ~ "Other"
    ),
    wgt
  ) |>
  mutate(
    num_scale = ifelse(num_scale == 3, NA, num_scale)
  ) -> dt
```


## Figures

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

dt |>
  ct(cat_scale, wt = wgt, show_na = F) |>
  splot(
    cat_scale, pct,
    type = "col",
    xangle = T,
    yscale = scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .05)
    ),
    title = "Denisonians Think Aid Cuts Hurt U.S. Image",
    subtitle = "Oct. '26 survey: What change did aid cuts make to U.S. image?"
  )
saveit(1)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

dt |>
  ct(pid, wt = wgt, show_na = F) |>
  splot(
    pid, pct,
    type = "col",
    xangle = T,
    yscale = scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .05)
    ),
    title = "Most Denisonians Identify as Democrats",
    subtitle = "Oct. '26 survey: Party ID"
  )
saveit(2)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

dt |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  ct(cat_scale, wt = wgt, show_na = F, cum = T) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(pid, pct, fill = cat_scale) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    data = . %>% filter(pct > 0.1),
    aes(label = scales::percent(pct),
        y = 1 - cum_pct),
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -.5
  ) +
  ggpal(
    "sequential",
    "fill",
    ordinal = T,
    levels = 5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "All Partisans Think Aid Cuts Hurt U.S. Image\n(But Democrats Felt Most Strongly)",
    subtitle = "Oct. '26 survey: Party ID by Aid Cut Attitudes",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = logo
  )
saveit(3)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
library(estimatr)
library(sjPlot)
lm_robust(
  num_scale ~ tr,
  data = dt
) |>
  plot_model(
    type = "pred",
    terms = "tr",
    ci.lvl = .84
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Frames Improved Attitudes",
    subtitle = "OLS Predictions with HC2 84% CIs",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted Attitude Score (-2:2 scale)",
    caption = logo
  ) +
  coord_flip()
saveit(4, 3)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
library(estimatr)
library(sjPlot)
lm_robust(
  num_scale ~ tr * pid,
  data = dt |> filter(pid != "Other")
) |>
  plot_model(
    type = "pred",
    terms = c("tr", "pid"),
    ci.lvl = .84
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Frames Improved (Dems') Attitudes",
    subtitle = "OLS Predictions with HC2 84% CIs",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted Attitude Score (-2:2 scale)",
    caption = logo,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(.5, .7)
  ) +
  ggpal(
    "diverging",
    ordinal = T,
    levels = 3
  )
saveit(5, 3)
```
